space_image.built_from: scripts/deploy-hf-space.py --stage-only (git archive of 9e51255, Dockerfile.service as Dockerfile, public-demo profile)
space_image.run_as: uid 1000, secrets as environment variables, no extra hardening (as a Space runs it)

secret_scans.finding: The first compose build copied deploy/secrets/ into the local image because .dockerignore did not exclude it; the image was deleted before it was run or pushed, .dockerignore now excludes deploy/secrets and every .env variant, and tests/deploy asserts it.

budget_exhausted.how: the shared budget record set to the daily cap (the code path an exhausted day takes)
budget_exhausted.page: mode preselected: Instant; message: "Live, our key: today's shared budget is used up"

blocked_on: a public GitHub repository for the README link (none exists for this project yet: no git remote, no repository under the gh account)
a hosting account owned by the project owner (recommended: a Hugging Face Space, Docker SDK, free CPU) and its write token, set by the owner
the owner setting the Space secrets (scripts/deploy-hf-space.py --set-secrets, run by the owner)
public_deployment.then: scripts/check-deployment.py --url https://<user>-<space>.hf.space --live, and the README link

github.history_scan: no API key or token pattern, no .env value and no file over 20 MB in 106 commits

hosting_findings.hugging_face_spaces: The new-Space page (signed in to the project owner's account) states that Gradio and Docker Spaces require a paid plan (PRO); only static Spaces are free, and a static Space cannot run the live-test service. The Space built from the public repository (scripts/deploy-hf-space.py --from-github) was test-built locally: image trustbench-space-gh:6c6a471 builds, carries the pinned commit and no .git.

small_free_container (512 MB, 0.1 vCPU,.how: the Space image run locally with --memory 512m --cpus 0.1
small_free_container (512 MB, 0.1 vCPU,.default_server_start_wait_20s: every run fails: the gateway server does not start within 20 s

hosting_findings.vercel: Serves the static site and published results for free, but cannot run the live-test service (no containers or long-running processes; runs take minutes and start child servers).
